Your next script starts here.

  1. Find an action. Search uses predefined keywords and aliases. Unsupported requests show no results.
  2. Make it yours. Configure each step, then use the arrows to reorder it. The preview updates as you type.
  3. Review and export. Copy or download the script. Shellify never runs it.

Scripts have not been tested in your environment. Check permissions, modules, and compatibility before running. Service restarts can interrupt users; confirmation is enabled by default.
